subject: Alto Health SOC2 request: KEK wrapping evidence + rotation snapshots
messages:
From: Pete Nguyen <pete@altohealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@altohealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: KEK wrapping proof and rotation snapshots for SOC2 audit

Hi Laura,

We are preparing the Alto Health SOC2 evidence packet and need to collect the encryption artifacts that demonstrate key wrapping and rotation behavior for tenant keys in Redwood Private. Specifically can you provide: 
- A short description of the KEK wrapping scheme used for tenant BYOK and service-managed keys (algorithms, any KMS/HSM boundary)
- Export (CSV) of rotation events for tenant KEKs for the last 12 months (timestamp, actor, reason, pre/post-hash)
- Any HSM attestation IDs or seals (if the KEK was wrapped in an HSM) and the associated cert thumbprints

This is time-sensitive — auditor first pass is next Wednesday. If there are redaction rules we should follow, flag them and we will coordinate.

Thanks,
Pete Nguyen
Security Program Manager
Alto Health
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: pete@altohealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KEK wrapping proof and rotation snapshots for SOC2 audit

Ben / Jonas — looping you in to pull the artifacts Pete requested. Ben, please pull the rotation export and the KEK wrapping summary; Jonas, please surface any HSM attestations and cert thumbprints we can share (redact serials if needed).

Key constraints: do not include private key material or full key material dumps. Prefer the minimal evidence set (hashes, event logs, attestation IDs). Attach the files to the secure Drive link listed below and mark PRD: ALTO-SOC2 in the HubSpot ticket.

Pete — we will upload the evidence to a restricted Drive folder and confirm when done.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: pete@altohealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KEK wrapping proof and rotation snapshots for SOC2 audit

Laura / Jonas / Pete — attaching two artifacts per the ask: kek-wrap-summary-2028-05-21.pdf (one-pager describing wrapping algorithms, KMS boundaries, and our BYOK procedure) and rotation-snapshot-2028-05-01.csv (export of rotation events for tenant KEKs for the last 12 months). Highlights: 

- Wrapping: tenant KEKs are wrapped with an HSM-backed KEK in our Dedicated KMS. AES-256-GCM is used for at-rest wrapping; RSA-OAEP-256 is used for transport-wrapped exchanges with customer-managed HSMs where configured. We include the scheme id and algorithm in the log entries.
- HSM boundary: for Private deployments where customers provide HSMs, wrapping occurs inside the customer HSM and we store only the wrapped blob and attestation id; for hosted Dedicated, wrapping occurs within our FIPS-validated HSM cluster (attestation IDs included).
- Rotation CSV: columns = [timestamp, kek_id (redacted), actor, trigger, previous_hash, new_hash, attestation_id (nullable), notes]. kek_id is hashed (sha256) in export to avoid exposing identifiers.

Attachments (metadata): kek-wrap-summary-2028-05-21.pdf (doc, 1 page); rotation-snapshot-2028-05-01.csv (CSV export). I redacted full serial numbers; attestation IDs are included where available.

Next steps: Laura, Jonas — if this looks good, I will upload to the restricted Drive folder and update HubSpot HS-REQ-4721. Pete — let us know if auditor needs raw PKCS#7 attestation bundles; we will coordinate a secure transfer.

-ben
Ben Carter
Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: kek-wrap-summary-2028-05-21.pdf (summary), rotation-snapshot-2028-05-01.csv (rotation export)
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: pete@altohealth.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KEK wrapping proof and rotation snapshots for SOC2 audit

Pete — we uploaded the two files to the restricted folder and shared with Alto Health Security (security@altohealth.com). Drive link: https://drive.restricted.redwood/alto/soc2/KEK-WRAP-2028-05-21 (access: view-only, expiration 2028-06-04). HubSpot ticket HS-REQ-4721 updated with the file pointers and a short explanation of redaction decisions. 

Note on redactions: we replaced kek_id values with SHA256(hex) placeholders, removed HSM serials where the customer requested non-disclosure, and included attestation IDs and certificate thumbprints (cert thumbprints show only last 8 chars). If the auditor requires unredacted cert chains we will arrange an encrypted SFTP transfer that includes PKCS#7 bundles and the HSM CA chain under an NDA cover page.

Let us know if you want an abbreviated narrative for the SOC2 control narrative (we can provide a 1–2 paragraph summary tying artifacts to control CC6.1/CC6.2).

Irene Choi
Director, Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference
